thread:
maria (marketing): Quick sync — Catalyst customer story is draft-ready. Recording + transcript live in the drive. We need: final hero quote, legal checks, and a short webinar tie-in blurb. Target publish: Mon 4/7.

aj (growth): Nice. Where are the drafts / quotes? I only see the raw transcript.

maria (marketing): Drive link: https://drive.redwood/catalyst/interview-1767 (permissions open to marketing). Draft blog is at /workspaces/marketing/catalyst-draft.md. I pulled two candidate quotes inline.

taylor (legal): Looping in — I can review but quick heads-up: redaction needed for any explicit ARR or customer PII. Preferable to replace specific $ with ranges or qualitative terms.

aj (growth): Understood. Hero quote candidates: "Redwood cut our inference costs by half while improving latency for real users" or "Inference finally feels production-ready for our analytics team" — which is stronger?

sam (product): First one is punchier for benchmarks. Second reads more product-y. Either works depending on landing page framing.

maria (marketing): I'll pitch the first as hero and keep the second as a pull quote. @taylor can you confirm redaction suggestion? Also need legal approval on customer name usage (Catalyst is fine but they asked to avoid full product revenue numbers).

taylor (legal): Confirmed — remove specific revenue figures, redact any exact user counts. Replace with: "significant revenue improvement" and "meaningful uplift in user latency". Also request a signed testimonial waiver — can someone ping the customer?

jess (ops): I can send the waiver template today. Do we want the signed waiver before publish or allow publish with conditional follow-up?

maria (marketing): Prefer signed before publish. I'll ask the customer in the email and offer the waiver + a 30-min review call.

aj (growth): Webinar tie-in: can we run a short customer panel the week after publish? Maybe Wed 4/9 at 10am PT. That gives sales a warm lead push.

sam (product): 4/9 works for product. We should coordinate a short demo + 10-min customer story. Need a single slide with numbers (redacted per legal).

maria (marketing): Draft webinar blurb: "Join Redwood + Catalyst to hear how they scaled inference cost-effectively and moved to production-grade latency. Includes short demo and customer Q&A." Thoughts?

aj (growth): Good. Add a CTA for sales: "Book a pilot review" in the follow-up email. Also ask for language localization for EMEA (short 1-paragraph).

taylor (legal): One more: we need to review the customer's logo usage. Customer said internal logo ok but no third-party co-branding in ads. Add that to the waiver.

maria (marketing): Noted. I'll update the waiver and send to jess to ping them.

publish-bot: Event scheduled:

- Legal signoff due: 1767778048
- Publish window: 1767763200..1767849600 (Mon 4/7)

maria (marketing): I'm going to send an email to the customer now with waiver + draft. Will paste the hero quote and ask for permission to use name/logo and a 10-min approval window for small edits.

aj (growth): If they approve the hero quote, I'll draft the paid social snippets and 3 ads.

jess (ops): Waiver sent. Email thread timestamp: 1767778019. Will update when signed.

maria (marketing): Thanks — keeping this thread for approvals. I'll ping again once waiver signed and will post final copy here for a last quick read. :raised_hands:
